mission: Give every sellable DreamCo bot a reusable end-to-end revenue organization instead of treating lead generation as the whole sales system.
lead_generation_boundary: Lead generation finds and qualifies prospects. It does not replace outreach orchestration, discovery, demos, proposals, pricing, contracting, payments, customer success, reviews, upsells, renewals, referrals, affiliates or win-back.
sales_controls: Use verified capabilities only in claims.
No unsolicited outreach where prohibited; obey consent, anti-spam, telemarketing and platform rules.
Real calls/messages/posts require authorized adapters and configured approval scope.
Real ad spend requires explicit budget authority.
Contracts and binding representations require appropriate authority.
Revenue is counted only from verified authorized payment events, not projections.
truth_rule: Revenue OS is an orchestration contract. Each engine must earn implementation and runtime status through repository and sandbox evidence.
